description:
Goal

A demanded TransportShape(position) monotonically refines exact semantic producer/use relations into one physical representation. ABI, backend, interpreter, and native consumers use that answer directly; no lower layer reselects identity from Ty, joined physical surfaces, ShapeId, ordering, or session inventories.

North-star contract

- There is no transport seal, completion pass, whole-world census, or no-change completion signal.
- One requested product produces from exact current fact/product reads or returns exact waits.
- Completion is relative to the exact OutgoingEdgeFrontier generation already requested by the product DAG.
- Dependency states and generations are memo metadata, never ProductValue data.
- Only actual product back-edges form a local settlement group.
- Refinement preserves upstream identity and relations; it never reconstructs them from a physical summary.
- One local semantic authority must not be duplicated into a second Ty/demand snapshot merely for transport.

Established foundation

fz-k22.5.1 provides immutable revisioned products, durable exact fact/product dependencies, final FactMovement states, atomic requested-publisher frontier generations, replaceable OutgoingInputEdges(E) contributions, IncomingInputRelations(root), exact IncomingInputSlot(slot) projections, and targeted closure retraction. This ticket consumes those authorities.

Proven paired callable case

The five-line fixture with two Enum.drop_while calls produces target reduce_while_cont/3 activation Ty(87), semantic input 2, with two exact CallArgument sources: reduce_while/3 Ty(81) ValueId(2) and Ty(219) ValueId(2).

The source values remain distinct semantic relations. Their child layouts are ShapeId(26)/CallableId(2)/ValueRef and ShapeId(29)/CallableId(3)/ValueRef; the target public carrier is ShapeId(39)/CallableId(4)/ValueRef. IncomingInputSource (ExecutableKey, ValueId, role) and CallableFlow preserve identity. Shape equality is not the semantic boundary.

The exact local branches are:

A: F172/Ty81 V2 -> F168/Ty69 V2 -> F70/Ty69 V2 -> F66/Ty41 V5 -> Lambda F160(captures=[V1])
B: F172/Ty219 V2 -> F168/Ty217 V2 -> F70/Ty217 V2 -> F66/Ty214 V5 -> Lambda F160(captures=[V1])

The candidate physical graph contains 50 shape nodes and 154 edges, including 2 capture children, 14 resolution inputs, 6 returns, and 27 shared dependencies. It is acyclic. Forward and reverse publisher service produce identical relations, layouts, generations, recipes, and graph. The candidate reaches 103 exact keys versus the legacy closure's 416 positions; this is graph size, not a runtime claim.

CallableDemand is sufficient use authority: resolved/targets with non-first-class use permits direct transport; opaque, escape, first-class use, or multiple identities requires the public ValueRef carrier. Zero relations is exact absence; a missing child is a wait. Equal child layouts never select one identity.

Proven recursive callable groups and publication

Actual recursive fixtures produce only exact TransportShape back-edges:

- self: X = join(A, X), SCC {X};
- mutual: X = join(A, Y), Y = join(X), SCC {X,Y};
- maplist: a one-member self SCC.

Recipe, slot, construction, and anchor dependencies remain outside those SCCs. A test-only ProductMemo group operation proves atomic installation for {X} and {X,Y}: every member and dependency is installed before external readers are invalidated, internal edges are excluded, only changed members advance generation, and no callback, telemetry handler, or user code runs during installation. Clean install, withdrawal, equal reproduction, changed anchors, reader invalidation, and forward/reverse order pass.

Complete legacy vocabulary inventory

- ExecutableReturn joins reachable LocalValue and CallsiteReturn sources.
- ExecutableInput(i) physical layout reads precise ActivationInputs evidence and input RuntimeDemand. Its CallableConstruction owner separately reads exact IncomingInputSlot identities and source-owner answers.
- LocalValue(v) has one normalized final origin after step origin, clause-input alias, call-result alias, and delivered join precedence.
- CallsiteReturn(c) names selected target ExecutableReturn children at the exact callsite need; provider boundary absence is explicit.
- Join names a canonical set of local/callsite children.
- TupleValue names ordered children under tuple-field demands.
- TupleField names its parent and field index.
- CallableValue names function/captures plus upstream CallableFlowFact.
- CallArg conforms to selected target ExecutableInput layouts (or the explicit provider contract); ReturnPayload names the direct callee return or CallsiteReturn; EntryCapture aliases Value; ResumePayload names the producer return or delivered local/callsite source according to stable body/callsite facts.
- Cross-executable call arguments and callable captures publish exact IncomingInputSource identities through CallInputMode, selected activations, needs, flow resolutions, and capture ordinals.

Proven authority correction

ActivationAnalysis and ExecutableFacts do not contain ActivationInputs. Recursive canonical activation keys deliberately converge non-dispatch identity: compiler2_activation_inputs_are_distinct_from_the_canonical_activation_key proves list(int) body evidence remains precise while the key becomes non-equivalent list(any). Deriving an input Ty from the key, clause values, or ShapeId would reverse-engineer discarded information.

No LocalTransportRecipes product is justified. ExecutableFacts(E) is the sole immutable local structural authority. It may normalize value origins, return sources, resume sources, position aliases, and selected mappings only when those replace equivalent raw LoweredBody interpretation. It never contains Ty, RuntimeDemand, ShapeId, TransportLayout, child answers, or copied CallableFlow.

TransportShape(Input) reads settled ActivationInputs and RuntimeDemand(E) directly. Return reads settled ReturnType, RuntimeDemand, ExecutableFacts, and child products. Value reads ExecutableFacts analysis/type/origin, RuntimeDemand, and children. CallArg reads selected target ExecutableInput shapes. CallsiteReturn reads selected target return products. CallableConstruction reads function/captures from ExecutableFacts and flow from RuntimeDemand; an input construction owner additionally reads IncomingInputSlot identities and source-owner answers.

The full-vocabulary fixture proof covers all 13 legacy source/position categories across pair_down, an opaque branch join, maplist, a direct tail return, and paired drop_while. A reachable opaque/provider callsite may have no selected summary; local CallArg flow remains named while target absence remains explicit.

Proven call-boundary ABI direction

The enum_predicate_search trace falsifies input-to-producer physical refinement. F180 input2 has exact ActivationInputs Ty439 and RuntimeDemand TupleFields([Whole,Whole]); its source is F203 V6, which aliases F203 input1 with the same physical authority. IncomingInputSlot membership for the same specialization moves from empty to one to several F193/F204 sources as the requested publisher frontier grows. Making ExecutableInput layout depend on those producer layouts makes the callee ABI move with caller discovery and repeatedly invalidates the chain.

The callee input owns its physical ABI from settled ActivationInputs plus RuntimeDemand. CallArg reads the selected target ExecutableInput layout so each caller conforms to that already-owned ABI. A Value that aliases an executable input reads that input. Semantic identity takes a separate path: CallableConstruction(ExecutableInput) reads the input layout, IncomingInputSlot identities, and source CallableConstruction owners. This preserves exact callable resolutions/publications without letting a growing caller frontier redefine physical layout. Nested callable tuple fields follow their field demand through the same split. Provider/opaque absence uses its explicit provider boundary contract.

Proven all-shape refinement and carrier

The real pair_down fixture has R = join(Tuple(int,int), R). For a fixed authoritative generic (Ty,demand) layout, the finite recursive domain is absence; exact lane/callable/tuple children; public callable; and boxed value. Equal layouts remain exact. Tuple joins are pointwise. Distinct concrete callable fields may widen to an authoritative public callable inside an exact tuple. Alternatives admitted by a union/value-lane authority widen to the boxed layout. Only a candidate not below the recursive authoritative layout is an invariant error.

TransportCarrier is an independent Absent < ValueRef dimension of the same final TransportLayout. It OR-joins through named structural/equality edges. Seeds come from RuntimeDemand public/first-class use, ExecutableFacts closure-call payload mode, and the CallableConstruction answer that owns capture ABI. Carrier is never inferred from ShapeId or session publication inventories.

No-anchor, equal anchors, self recursion, nested callable widening, union widening, incompatible structure, carrier propagation, forward/reverse traversal, source replacement, withdrawal, and equal reproduction pass through the existing atomic ProductMemo group mechanism. Internal SCC edges are excluded from retained dependencies; exact external reads remain durable. No source form remains unmodeled.

Proven construction ownership correction

CallableFacts(CallableId) and BoundaryFacts(BoundaryId) cannot independently produce. CallableId and BoundaryId are physical interner results minted while refining a position; they do not identify the semantic construction owner or its prerequisites. Their current producers read PullSession inventories, while root/backend discovery and CodegenSeamFacts scan accumulated demanded ids. An id-to-owner index would preserve that forbidden authority.

Two real fixtures prove data loss. Specialized make(seed) activations at distinct Value positions intern the same CallableId and layout but own different direct surfaces and specialized lambda resolutions; the global CallableFacts map keeps only the last insertion. Separate left()/right() values returning the same &inc/1 intern the same CallableId and BoundaryId but own different publication positions; record_boundary_facts replacement keeps only the last writer.

The exact TransportPosition is the sufficient semantic owner for concrete constructions, generic joins, executable inputs, and resume/callsite publications. CallableConstruction(position) carries final layout, optional concrete construction, callable facts, and boundary facts. CallableId and BoundaryId remain physical descriptor values inside that answer and are grouping keys only. construction=None is an exact answer for generic/opaque owners, not absence of ownership.

ProductMemo proofs with two owners sharing physical ids pass: structural aggregation is identical forward/reverse; replacement and withdrawal retract only the changed owner's resolutions/publications; equal reproduction preserves generation; the unrelated owner and ABI reader remain clean. No Debug/render order, owner index, cache, pass, seal, provenance field, or session scan is required.

The proved lower DAG is CallableConstruction(position) -> AbiExecutable(owner E) -> BackendExecutable(E) -> RootBackendProduct(root). Abi reads exact owner products and embeds immutable owner answers; Backend carries Abi; Root order-free aggregates only values embedded in reached Backend products by physical id. Values, not keys, cross the ABI boundary, so root gains no second cross-cutting dependency set. This permits deletion of CallableFacts, BoundaryFacts, CodegenSeamFacts product keys/values/producers, demanded-id sets, callable/boundary/construction session inventories, backend demanded-id scans, artifact session lookups, and seam-fact inventory scans.

Proven callable owner SCC settlement

After correcting physical ABI direction, real callable owner graphs contain separate exact semantic cycles. Self recursion and maplist each produce {CallableConstruction(input), CallableConstruction(alias value)}. Mutual recursion produces a four-member left/right input/alias ring. Concrete construction=Some owners, generic join terminals, settled layouts, IncomingInputSlot, ExecutableFacts, RuntimeDemand, and ActivationInputs remain external. Tuple-return/resume/capture and recursive callable-return owner graphs are acyclic.

Each SCC member is a pass-through construction=None answer. For a fixed current source frontier, its finite domain is structural union of exact resolutions, direct surfaces/edges, boundary facts, and owner-local publications; layout is a separate immutable TransportShape dependency per member. Two- and four-member equations settle identically forward/reverse. Exact TransportPosition structural ordering canonicalizes publications; Debug/render order is forbidden.

Production ProductMemo group proofs pass for owner groups: atomic visibility, internal-edge stripping, union of all group-external dependencies onto every member, equal reproduction, external-owner replacement and withdrawal, source-frontier membership change with SCC rediscovery, owner-local publication propagation, forward/reverse order, and unrelated owner/ABI coldness. The group contains only mutually reachable pending CallableConstruction keys and remains distinct from TransportShape settlement. No provisional owner value, broader cone, source skipping, index, cache, pass, or seal is needed.

Implementation guidance from the trace: generic owner production must consume its independently settled TransportShape instead of recomputing layout; selected return/resume ownership must continue through ExecutableReturn to the nested terminal callable owner; BoundaryFacts publications must be structurally canonicalized. No observed owner SCC needs a richer domain or contains a concrete construction.

Implementation strategy

1. Replace ExecutableFacts' duplicate delivered-join/callable-producer views and transport.rs' separate LocalCallableProducer/TransportSource reconstruction with one minimal normalized local origin vocabulary inside ExecutableFacts. Preserve explicit absent selected targets.
2. Make each TransportShape(position) consume that structural authority plus its exact settled fact/product reads. ExecutableInput derives physical layout only from settled ActivationInputs and RuntimeDemand; CallArg conforms to selected target ExecutableInput products; input-alias Values read their input. Callsite returns name selected target returns. CallableConstruction(position) is the only lower callable/boundary fact product, consumes its settled TransportShape layout, follows IncomingInputSlot/source-owner identities independently of physical input layout, and continues selected return/resume ownership through ExecutableReturn to nested terminal owners.
3. Detect exact reentry separately by product domain. A TransportShape SCC settles physical layout from bottom under the authoritative generic layout. A CallableConstruction SCC settles only mutually reachable pass-through owner keys by finite structural fact union while reading settled per-member TransportShape layouts. Publish each exact group atomically through ProductMemo with group-wide external dependencies and internal edges stripped. Never mix the two domains or sweep recipes, slots, anchors, concrete constructions, or a dependency cone into either group.
4. Embed exact CallableConstruction owner answers in Abi/Backend artifacts and aggregate reached values only at root packaging. Delete CallableFacts, BoundaryFacts, CodegenSeamFacts product families; demanded-id sets; callable/boundary/construction session inventories; all owner/id scans; and the whole closure solver with ExecutableContext/TransportContexts inventories, ShapeConstraintGraph/PositionUnion, Cycle/ProjectionMemo, component products, selector/fallback, manufactured demand, consult/freshness ledgers, session closure state, closure ids in absence values, temporary probes, and obsolete cache/resource tests. Replace mechanical ShapeId/component/inventory assertions with behavioral or architectural intent tests; do not preserve obsolete resource floors.
5. Update northstar and agent documentation to describe direct position refinement, exact local authorities, recursive group settlement, and carrier ownership. Remove all WIP spike scaffolding and noisy eprintln probes.

Rejected boundaries

- filtering identities through joined demand, rendered Ty, ShapeId, CallableId, debug order, or physical equality;
- generic fallback as semantic evidence;
- recovering identity downstream after boxing;
- treating a dependency cone as an SCC;
- sequential per-key publication presented as atomic settlement;
- a parallel stamped cache/facade;
- historical ExecutableTransportFacts;
- LocalTransportRecipes as a duplicate authority carrying copied types and demands;
- an id-to-owner index, demanded-id inventory, or session scan that treats physical CallableId/BoundaryId as semantic product ownership.

Signal

- The paired input layout is owned by precise ActivationInputs/RuntimeDemand; its CallableConstruction owner pulls both exact source owners and no unrelated component, so both identities survive into one public callable ABI.
- Precise input layouts depend on settled ActivationInputs and RuntimeDemand, not the converged activation key or the moving caller frontier; CallArg layouts depend on selected target inputs.
- Every transport position is one local structural mapping plus exact named fact/product reads.
- Recursive settlement groups exactly reentered shape keys and publishes no provisional value.
- Callable and non-callable lattices are finite, schedule-independent, replacement-safe, and explicit about invalid states.
- Forward and reverse schedules produce equal values and generations without debug/render sorting.
- Whole-closure projection, inventories, selectors/fallbacks, manufactured demand, and custom freshness state are deleted, not bypassed.
- Full library tests, targeted fixtures, strict all-target clippy, formatting, and before/after product/work measurements pass.

Scope

All proof gates, including physical layout SCCs, construction ownership, corrected call-boundary ABI direction, and semantic owner SCCs, have passed. Production implementation may resume only under the disjoint exact-group and position-owned/ABI-embedded strategy above; no compatibility index, source skipping, mixed SCC, or session-backed construction path may land. fz-k22.30 remains blocked until this implementation lands. fz-k22.31 owns the uncalled first-class discrepancy. fz-k22.29 may consume the landed authority only after it exists.
title: Make transport shape a product-owned refinement
